Privacy Policy of the «Diary» App

Effective date: 18.10.2026
Version: 1.0

1. General provisions
This Privacy Policy defines the procedure for collecting, using, storing, transferring and protecting information about the user when using the «Diary» mobile application.

By using the App, the user confirms that they have read this Policy, fully agree to its terms and consent to the processing of personal and other data.

If the user does not agree to the terms of this Policy, they must not use the App.

2. What data we collect
The App may process the following categories of data:

 2.1. Data created by the user
 - Text entries, notes, titles, dates, tags, images and other materials created by the user («User Content»);
 - App settings.

 2.2. Account data (when using synchronization)
When the synchronization or authorization function is enabled to sync between devices, the App may receive account identification data (for example, email address, account identifier), used solely for the synchronization function.

 2.3. Technical data (collected automatically)
When using the App, the following may be collected automatically:
 - Device identifier (Android ID, SSAID), advertising identifier (Google Advertising ID) and/or other identifiers required for analytics and advertising services;
 - Device model, Android OS version, language, time zone, region;
 - Network connection information (IP address, network type — Wi-Fi/mobile network);
 - Event logs, error and crash information (crash reports);
 - App usage statistics (screen views, button presses, features used, usage time).

 2.4. Data during synchronization
When synchronization is enabled, User Content may be transmitted and stored on servers used to provide this function. The scope of transmitted data is limited to the content the user has chosen to synchronize.

The App does not collect or process special categories of personal data.

3. Purposes of data processing
 - Providing, operating and supporting the App's core functions;
 - Ensuring synchronization of user data between the user's devices (when activated);
 - Ensuring stable and secure operation of the App, identifying and fixing errors;
 - Analyzing App usage to improve it and develop features (analytics);
 - Providing personalized or non-personalized advertising to support and develop the App (monetization);
 - Complying with applicable law and preventing misuse.

4. Third-party services and transfer of data to third parties
For these purposes, the App uses third-party SDKs:

 4.1. Analytics services (already in use)
The following may be used: Firebase Analytics (Google LLC), Google Crashlytics (Google LLC), Yandex.Metrica (YANDEX LLC), MyTracker (My.com).

 4.2. Advertising services (to be used)
The following may be used: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) (Google LLC), Yandex.Direct/advertising technologies of Yandex (YANDEX LLC) and other advertising SDKs.

 4.3. Synchronization and storage services (when synchronization is enabled)
When synchronization is enabled, User Content may be transmitted via the chosen synchronization mechanism (the App's own backend or third-party cloud services) solely for synchronization and backup.

Privacy policies:
 - Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
 - Firebase: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
 - Yandex.Metrica: https://metrica.yandex.ru/about/privacy-policy
 - AdMob: https://support.google.com/admob/answer/7665968
 - MyTracker: https://my.com/privacy/policy/

5. Storage and deletion of data
 5.1. Local storage. User Content is stored by default solely on the user's device.
 5.2. Storage during synchronization. When synchronization is enabled, copies of User Content may be stored on synchronization servers for the time necessary to provide the function, or until the user deletes the data.
 5.3. Data deletion. The user may delete User Content in the App. With synchronization, deletion on one device may result in deletion on other synchronized devices. At the user's request, data on synchronization servers is deleted within a reasonable time, except where storage is required by law.

6. Data security
Reasonable technical and organizational measures are taken to protect data. However, absolute security is not guaranteed.

7. User rights
The user has the right to: review the list of processed data; request correction of inaccurate data; restrict processing where technically possible; delete their data; withdraw consent by ceasing to use the App.

8. Changes to this Policy
The current version of the Policy is posted in «Settings» → «Privacy Policy». A new version takes effect upon publication. Continued use after it takes effect constitutes acceptance of the new version.

9. Contacts
For questions related to this Policy, data processing or the exercise of user rights, contact: slava13795kush@mail.ru
